recommendation: Keep the source fix. It removes a user-visible contradiction with the current DataAbsentReason code system while leaving the already-correct terminology and bindings untouched; normal publication generation should carry the corrected example into generated pages.
issue_request: FHIR-15567 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3. It requested data-absent-reason code, definition, hierarchy, mapping, and value set updates, including readable FHIR codes, corrected floating-point error definitions and hierarchy, removal of inaccurate mappings, removal of the redundant observation-valueabsentreason value set, and bindings to data-absent-reason with NaN/PINF/NINF retained parenthetically in displays.
initial_application: The issue was historically pre-applied in commits 2ebdf2bb94, dee72c96d2, and d06b52856c, which updated the DAR codes, removed source/observation/valueset-observation-valueabsentreason.xml, rebound Observation to data-absent-reason, and added parenthetical display abbreviations. Current ValueSet and Observation binding source were already correct, but source/observation/observation-notes.xml still had a JSON example using code "NaN" and display "Not a Number".
additional_context: The current THO CodeSystem data-absent-reason defines not-a-number under error with display Not a Number (NaN), plus negative-infinity and positive-infinity under error. A 2018 Zulip community-consultation announcement for GF#15567/GF#13521/GF#10556 confirmed the intended breaking change from NAN to not-a-number. FHIR-10556 and FHIR-13521 are same-family DAR issues but were not independently reconciled here; FHIR-13066 was a mistaken issue-number mention and is unrelated Location.mode work.
reconciliation: Changed source/observation/observation-notes.xml so the active Observation narrative recommends 'not-a-number' and the JSON dataAbsentReason example uses code "not-a-number" with display "Not a Number (NaN)". No terminology or binding source edits were needed because those sources already match the final decision.
source_changes: source/observation/observation-notes.xml: replaced the obsolete 'NaN' DataAbsentReason recommendation and JSON code with 'not-a-number' and display 'Not a Number (NaN)'.
